card.name: Endings of all-caps heading words
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word written in capital letters, such as ORAL, CHILDREN or RENAL, in section headings of drug labels. It fires as the capitalized word is completed.

modes.label: Split caps medical words
modes.description: Final piece of an all-caps label heading word like ORAL, RENAL, CHILDREN or SYSTEMIC.

modes.label: Other capitalized words
modes.description: Ending piece of other all-caps words, such as names or units, outside medical headings.
